exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix lease-

exec card --actor migration-runner lease acquire customer-schema --ttl 45m
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/customer-schema.txt
! stderr .

# Acquisition cannot extend an existing lease, even for its current owner.
! exec card --actor migration-runner lease acquire customer-schema --ttl 2h
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/held.txt
! exec card --actor report-worker lease acquire customer-schema --ttl 10m
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/held.txt

exec card lease show customer-schema
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/customer-schema.txt
! stderr .

-- golden/customer-schema.txt --
customer-schema	migration-runner	2026-07-12T12:00:00Z	2026-07-12T12:45:00Z
-- golden/held.txt --
error: lease "customer-schema" is held by "migration-runner" until 2026-07-12T12:45:00Z
